finding: Pivot ownership floor(k*ranks/n) disagrees with floor(n*rank/ranks) row-update boundaries at non-divisible sizes. At n=513 with 128 ranks, row 4 is updated by rank 1 but selected by rank 0 with stale entries. A rank detecting a nonpositive diagonal returns before the current MPI_Bcast, then enters the later MPI_Reduce while its peers remain in the broadcast. This provides a concrete ownership defect and an unmatched-collective failure path.
observed_failure: Both the original two-program execution and one exclusive serial control time out at the unchanged 30-second limit after entering factorization. They use the identical binary SHA, input, rank count, affinity, containment limits and reference. The paired original check passes in 15.148503 seconds.
interpretation: The timeout reproduces without concurrent scheduling. The source defects are consistent with a deadlock, although the exact runtime branch was not traced. Retain the original external-validation failure; the isolated control is separate diagnostic evidence and does not replace the canonical record.
investigation: Static inspection and one separately retained exclusive correctness control; no performance benchmark and no replacement of the original failure.
